mathematical_definition: causal_rolling_mean(log(h/c)*log(h/o) + log(l/c)*log(l/o), window=60) -- Rogers-Satchell per-bar variance proxy (NOT sqrt'd despite the '_vol' name: features.volatility.rogers_satchell returns the rolling-averaged variance quantity directly), drift-independent, rolling-averaged over a trailing 60-bar window
numerical_stability_notes: Non-finite per-bar values are set to NaN before the rolling mean
missing_value_policy: NaN for windows with fewer than 60 observed bars, never zero-filled
